high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "barelyopinionated." The post is titled "DIVISION OF STATES AFTER INDEPENDENCE" and compares the state divisions of India in 1956 and 2021. Title and Content: The title "DIVISION OF STATES AFTER INDEPENDENCE" is prominently displayed at the top. Below the title, there are two maps side by side: On the left, labeled "1956," shows the map of India with states as they were in 1956
